name: final-factory-agents
description: Final Factory agent tooling — skills and subagent roles shared across every clone, worktree, and branch of the game repo.

plugins.name: ff-agents
plugins.description: Core Final Factory development tooling: delegation roles (implementor, mech-executor, scout, Explore, build-verifier, deep-thinker, game-driver) plus the skills for deep thinking, determinism audits, driving the game, playtests, handoff/resume, and doc upkeep.

plugins.name: ff-speckit
plugins.description: Spec Kit workflow skills — specify, clarify, plan, tasks, analyze, checklist, implement, constitution, taskstoissues, and agent-context updates. Operates on the .specify/ machinery in the project you invoke it from.

plugins.name: ff-discord
plugins.description: Discord integration for Final Factory — triage bug reports from the #bug-reports forum, answer player questions in #ask-assistant, and ask the other developer a question in #dev-chat. Requires the ffdiscord bot credentials.
